definition: the yellow color, like a lemon
description: A pale lilac nursery with a white cot under a cream canopy, a round pink rug on the wooden floor and a cream armchair in the corner, filmed from the doorway. A bearded man is kneeling on the floor in an enormous bright yellow ball gown, the wide yellow skirt spread out all around him over the rug. In front of him a golden retriever sits in a red cape with a white ruff. The man leans down to the dog, picks up a yellow rubber bone from the rug and holds it out; the dog takes the yellow bone in its mouth and holds it there while he strokes its head and talks to it, the yellow skirt filling half the frame.

de.question: Was hält der Hund?
